filterText.commandList.name: Convert HTML to Markdown
filterText.commandList.description: Convert the selected HTML to Markdown (tables, lists, bold/italic, code, links, headings). Mintlify components and JSX (<Note>, <Frame>, style={{...}}, className) are preserved.

filterText.commandList.name: Format JSON
filterText.commandList.description: Pretty-print the selected JSON with 2-space indentation, keeping the indentation of the first selected line. Select whole lines so code blocks inside lists stay aligned.
